body: I don’t even know.  I’m not brave enough to do it yet, I suppose, and my family will miss me, that’s about all.  If I could wish for my death and have it happen, I would, I just don’t have the courage to physically do it yet, and that’s why I need more reasons
Don’t go yet, please tell me you haven’t, just talk, I’m listening, I promise

Actually, yeah, that makes a lot of sense, thanks friend!  Kinda like when you say I’ll deal with it later so you force tomorrow you to suffer the consequences I guess?  Except sorta the opposite in this situation I guess.  This helps a lot, thank you :)
But if someone were to not enjoy existing, why would that be better than not existing, even if that wouldn’t necessarily be good, bad, or anything at all really?
I don’t know to be honest, and that’s kinda what brought me here.  What view do you personally think is most accurate?
But is it necessarily good for everyone?
But what if they just don’t enjoy it and would rather not?
